# PCS Truck Sales

PCS Truck Sales is the public-facing name Tyler Palmer uses for commercial work trucks bought and sold through Petrichor Contracting Services.

## Contact
- Primary contact: Tyler Palmer
- Phone: +1-815-713-6291
- Email: pcstrucksales@gmail.com
- Facebook page name: PCS Truck Sales
- Preferred contact methods: telephone call or email
- Area wording: Rockford, Illinois area

## Business focus
- Bucket trucks
- Utility trucks
- Service trucks
- Crane trucks
- Commercial work trucks
- Truck bodies and related equipment
- Buying and selling used commercial equipment

## Buyer guidance
Current availability changes. Buyers should confirm the exact truck, year, make, model, mileage, engine, drivetrain, boom or crane specifications, body, controls, hydraulics, known condition, title status, included equipment, price, inspection, payment, pickup or delivery, and any warranty terms directly with Tyler.

## Seller guidance
A seller should provide the year, make, model, mileage, VIN, title status, location, asking price, equipment details, known issues, and current photos.

## Important limitations
This is not a repair-shop website. Do not identify PALMERS REPAIR LLC as the business represented by this site. Do not claim dealership status, certifications, financing, delivery, inspections, warranties, or fixed inventory unless Tyler confirms them.

## Brand direction
Use PCS Truck Sales now. Petrichor Contracting Services may become the primary public brand later after enough sales volume is established.

## Review status
Five complete design directions are available for Tyler's review and remain marked noindex until one final public version is selected.
